values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gravescrossing ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Graves Crossing State Forest Campground: 10 campsites, $20, managed by Young SP), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in access to the Jordan River just east of the campground entrance.

values.note: State forest campground roads may not be plowed in winter.

note: Rustic state forest campground in the Jordan River Valley along the Jordan River (Michigan's first designated scenic river), 10 mi N of Mancelona via US-131 and M-66 (Antrim County); managed by Young State Park. Carry-in canoe/kayak access just east of the entrance. A camper reported a 19-ft trailer fits comfortably. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 10 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (inherited max now confirmed), open all year (now manual). Note trimmed of field restatements and the '$15-20, 14-15-day' guesses.
